ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure, and the arrows need to be ignored. Three ester substituents are visible: CO2Me above, MeO2C on the lower left, and CO2Me on the lower right; on the right there is also a separated negatively charged OMe component. The central core contains a C/S skeleton and has an internal carbonyl C=O; the figure also has bonds connected to hydrogen, but the problem requires excluding all bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning count: Count by fragments. Among the three visible ester substituents, each ester fragment is counted as 4 bonds by heavy-atom bonds, namely the connecting bond, C=O, C-O, and O-Me, for a total of 4; the three esters total 3 × 4 = 12. The separated OMe anion on the right counts only this O-Me heavy-atom bond, as 1. In the remaining central transition-state core, after not double-counting the ester/methoxy expanded parts and after excluding hydrogen bonds and ignoring arrows, the heavy-atom bonds include the internal carbonyl C=O and C/S skeleton connections, totaling 8. Therefore the total is 12 + 1 + 8 = 21.

method.method_draft: Describe the image components, then count by fragments. For each of the three visible ester substituents, count 4 heavy-atom bonds, giving 12. Count the separate OMe anion at the right as 1 O-Me bond. Then count the remaining heavy-atom bonds drawn in the central transition-state core outside the ester/methoxy expansions, including the internal carbonyl C=O and the C/S framework, giving 8. Add the component counts: 12 + 1 + 8 = 21.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，箭头需要忽略。可见三个酯取代基，分别是上方的 CO2Me、左下的 MeO2C、右下的 CO2Me；右侧还有一个分离的带负电 OMe 组分。中央核心含有 C/S 骨架，并有一个内部羰基 C=O；图中还有连接到氢的键，但题目要求排除所有涉及氢的键。

推理计数：按片段计数。三个可见酯取代基中，每个酯片段按重原子键计为 4 个键，即连接键、C=O、C-O、O-Me，共 4 个；三个酯合计 3 × 4 = 12。右侧分离的 OMe 阴离子只计 O-Me 这个重原子键，为 1。剩余中央过渡态核心中，在不重复计算酯/甲氧基展开部分且排除氢键、忽略箭头后，重原子键包括内部羰基 C=O 以及 C/S 骨架连接，共 8 个。因此总数为 12 + 1 + 8 = 21。
